# PM Control Artifact Management References

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

This folder contains the artifact catalog and prescription logic used by PM Control during process runs. It is a self-contained operational copy of the relevant Project Artifact Prescription knowledge, not a second workflow.

## Purpose

Use these references to identify artifact candidates for a selected PMI process, inspect what already exists, decide the need and treatment, and keep the project artifact index lean.

## Loading Rules

| Task | Load | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Candidate selection | `process-artifact-map.md`, `artifact-catalog.md` | Identify artifacts relevant to the selected process |
| Gate sequence | `artifact-need-rules.md` | Apply the process-level decision sequence |
| Need and treatment | `essential-artifact-model.md`, `disposition-rules.md` | Decide whether information needs a maintained carrier |
| Existing artifact check | `artifact-completeness-model.md`, `evidence-standards.md` | Assess currentness, completeness, confidence, and traceability |
| Project tailoring | `project-assessment-model.md`, `prioritization-model.md` | Apply project conditions and timing |
| PM coverage | `pmi-pm-input-output-crosswalk.md` | Map PMBOK terms to catalog entries |
| BA coverage | `pmi-ba-input-output-crosswalk.md` | Map BA terms to catalog entries |
| Software delivery | `dev-crosswalk.md` | Apply DEV overlap and delivery-stage rules |
| Dependencies | `dependency-rules.md` | Record only dependencies relevant to proposed maintained actions |

## ID Convention

PM Control process IDs remain `PM-01` through `PM-40`. Artifact catalog source IDs remain unchanged for traceability, but PM Control refers to them internally as:

```text
ART-PM-01 through ART-PM-59
ART-BA-01 through ART-BA-35
ART-DEV-01 through ART-DEV-10
```

For example, catalog source ID `PM-44` is PM Control artifact ID `ART-PM-44`, Risk register. This prevents a process ID and an artifact ID from being confused.

## Operating Boundary

- Assess only candidates mapped to the selected process or an activated change trigger.
- Apply need before treatment.
- Inspect existing carriers before considering creation.
- Do not run the standalone seven-stage artifact prescription workflow here.
- Do not assess the full catalog during project-control setup.
- Keep detailed reasoning in the process run; keep approved current state in `artifact-index.md`.
- Generated views are not maintained sources of truth.
